ValidationRule.description: If the card is lost or stolen OR if the card has not been stopped, please select NA for this field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'Lost') , ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'Stolen'), ISPICKVAL( Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c , 'No') ) , OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL( Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c , 'NA')), ISPICKVAL( Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c , '') ), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the card is lost or stolen OR if the card has not been stopped, please select NA for this field.
